newsitem.title: USA: HemaCare stake raised by Kensington Capital.
newsitem.headline: HemaCare stake raised by Kensington Capital.

text.p: Kensington Capital Management Inc said on Tuesday it raised its stake in HemaCare Corp to 454,600 common shares or 6.33 percent from 5.1 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Kensington Capital said its latest transactions include the purchase of 103,500 common shares bought between September 19 and November 13 at prices ranging from $2.875 to $3.25 per share.
The stake is held for investment purposes, the filing said.
